niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
answer_verbatim:
Here are some solid options across different formats:

**Structured courses:**
- Udemy and Coursera have affordable psychology-based courses on shadow work (often $10-15 on sale)
- Insight Timer offers free and paid meditation/spiritual courses
- Masterclass has some well-regarded teachers, though pricier

**Specialized platforms:**
- Gaia (spiritual/esoteric focus) - subscription model
- The Shift Network - often event-based, higher price point
- Local community colleges sometimes offer psychology or mindfulness courses cheaply

**Things worth considering:**
- Shadow work is partly psychological (integrating disowned parts of yourself) and partly spiritual—courses mixing both perspectives tend to be more useful than purely one or the other
- Credentials matter less here than teacher transparency about their own training
- Free YouTube content from established therapists/teachers can be surprisingly good for exploring before paying
- Many people find shadow work works better with a therapist or guide rather than solo courses

**A practical approach:**
Start with something low-cost to see if the teaching style clicks with you. Shadow work can bring up difficult material, so having some support structure (even just a journal practice) matters.

What draws you to shadow work specifically? That might help narrow down what would actually serve you best.
